card.name: Inside gluc-uron and tax-onomy words
card.fires_on: The word piece partway through long scientific words, mainly 'uron' in glucuronidation and glucuronosyltransferase, and 'Tax' or 'tax' starting taxonomy words. It also fires on pieces like 'than' in lanthanum and 'ul' in granulocytic.

modes.label: Glucuronidation terms
modes.description: The 'uron' piece inside gluc-uron-idation or -osyltransferase in drug metabolism text.

modes.label: Taxonomy words
modes.description: 'Tax' or 'tax' beginning taxon, taxa or taxonomic in biology text.

modes.label: Other long word middles
modes.description: Middle pieces of rarer long words such as lanthanum or granulocytic.

card.writes: It favors word-continuation pieces like 'ide', 'ider', 'iden' and 'on', helping finish a long word.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of long technical words like glucuronidation and taxonomy, before the rest of the word.
